description: The file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate component in the SwabbleKit, focusing on matching wake-words and extracting commands from speech segments within a test suite.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating the WakeWordGate logic such as trigger matching and command extraction.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the wake word trigger requires a minimum gap after the trigger word before the command is recognized.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Tests that a command following the wake word trigger is correctly extracted when the gap condition is met.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Tests that multi-word trigger phrases are correctly recognized and processed.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Validates that command text extraction correctly handles scenario where segment ranges may be from different string references.
